<description>
`PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages()` is a ~500-line function handling every p2p conditional send message type inline, which makes it hard to navigate and review. This was reduced to less than 90 lines.

I've [identified](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34824#pullrequestreview-4445529843) this issue/ possible improvement while reviewing #34824.

-**_Notes_**:

First (prepare) commit removes the unnecessary `__func__` prefix from the debug logs in SendMessages(), as [suggested](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35522#issuecomment-6144362450) by maflcko. The logging macros already capture the calling function via `SourceLocation`, available on demand with `-logsourcelocations`.

Each of the following 17 commits represents a helper function extraction so it can be easily reviewed, it's only a pure code move, the only new lines are the declaration (with thread-safety annotations), the function signature, and the one-line call site, and they can be reviewed with the git options: `--color-moved=dimmed-zebra --color-moved-ws=ignore-all-space`.

One final cleanup commit normalises formatting and simplifies some of the extracted helpers, preserving existing control flow and lock scopes.
</description>
